parameters.name: AcceleratorType
parameters.description:
The accelerator type.

*   CPU: Only CPU computing is used.
*   GPU: GPUs are used to accelerate computing.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sorting order. Valid values:

*   ASC
*   DESC

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The field by which the query results are sorted. Set the value to gmtCreate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pai-dsw list-ecs-specs --accelerator-type CPU --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by gmtCreate --order DESC --resource-type example-string --api-version 2022-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun pai-dsw GET /api/v2/ecsspecs --region cn-hangzhou --Order DESC --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SortBy gmtCreate --ResourceType 'example-string' --AcceleratorType CPU --header "Content-Type=application/json"
